chapter.heading: Song of Victory over Zion’s EnemiesSong of Ascents.
chapter.v:
“Many a
time they have afflicted me from my youth,”Let Israel now say—

“Many a
time they have afflicted me from my youth;Yet they have not prevailed against me.

The plowers
plowed on my back;They made their furrows long.”

The Lord
is righteous;He has cut in pieces the cords of the wicked.

Let all
those who hate ZionBe put to shame and turned back.

Let them
be as the grass on the housetops,Which withers before it grows up,

With which
the reaper does not fill his hand,Nor he who binds sheaves, his arms.

Neither let
those who pass by them say,“The blessing of the Lord be upon you;We bless you in the name of the Lord!”
